home.month_title: How a payroll month gets closed
home.month_lead: The same four steps every month, with every detail kept in case SUNAFIL or an employee asks.

steps.t: You record what happened this month
steps.d: Hires, terminations, absences, overtime and vacations. Enter them in the system or upload them from Excel.
Contributions, deductions, fifth-category tax, bonuses and CTS with current rates. Before closing it shows what changed from last month and why.

steps.t: You approve and payslips are published
steps.d: Each employee sees and signs their payslip on their phone. Delivery is recorded.
Download the files for PLAME, AFPnet and T-Registro, and the payment file for your bank.

home.modules_lead: Start with what you need most. All three work on the same employee record, so nothing is entered twice.

home.portal_text: They see and sign their payslip, request vacations, download their employment certificate and update their details without emailing HR. They sign in with their ID even without an email address.

trust.t: Salaries only for those who should see them
trust.d: You decide who sees pay. Without the permission it isn't sent, on screen or in exports.
Who changed what, when and from where, with the previous value. That record can't be deleted.

home.plans_lead: You pay by number of employees and what you turn on. You can start with a trial.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: No. GestiaHR runs in the browser and your employees use it from their phones.

faq.q: Can I bring my current payroll?
faq.a: Yes. Import employees, salaries and year-to-date totals from Excel or your previous system, and run a month in parallel to compare before switching.

faq.q: What happens when a rate, the UIT or the minimum wage changes?
faq.a: Rates and caps are stored with their effective date and we keep them updated. Closed months don't change.

faq.q: Does it work for a MYPE company?
faq.a: Yes. Each employee is calculated under their company's regime: general, micro or small business.

home.closing_title: See it working with data like yours
home.closing_text: In a 30-minute demo we walk you through a full payroll month, from inputs to the signed payslip.
